decisions.statement: The reading is the share of processor time that was not idle between two takes.
Time spent waiting on a disk counts as idle.
Time a guest spent is counted once, under the time its host spent.
Two takes between which no processor time passed are no reading rather than zero.
A counter line that does not parse is no reading rather than zero.
Nothing here caches a reading or decides when a reading is taken.
Nothing here turns a share into a color.

definition: how much of the workstation's processor time is busy
